hero.label: RedNote & Douyin MCP
hero.title: RedNote and Douyin MCP: let your AI agent collect social data through your own browser
hero.description: The MediaClaw MCP server is a standard MCP (STDIO) server with 40+ tools. It collects RedNote (Xiaohongshu) and Douyin posts, videos, comments, profiles and search results, then extracts video transcripts and image text. Every page visit goes through the MediaClaw extension in your own browser, using the account you are already logged into, so the agent never sees your cookies. Codex, WorkBuddy and Doubao for Work are supported today.

items.question: Is there a RedNote (Xiaohongshu) MCP server that works with Codex?
items.answer: Yes. The MediaClaw MCP server covers RedNote and Douyin and works with Codex, WorkBuddy and Doubao for Work. On Codex there is no config file to write: copy the install prompt from the extension (System settings → Agent access), send it to Codex, and approve the pairing once in the extension.

items.question: How is an agent using MediaClaw different from a scraper?
items.answer: A scraper logs in and pages through results on its own, so you maintain its login state and runtime and get raw data back. With MediaClaw the agent views pages through the extension in your own browser and account, then can go on to transcripts, comment analysis and topic ideas. Before any new collection it shows you a plan and waits for your approval.

items.question: Can I use it in Claude, Cursor or other MCP clients?
items.answer: Codex, WorkBuddy and Doubao for Work are the officially supported hosts; installation and pairing are verified only for these three. Other clients are not supported yet. New hosts will be announced here and in the changelog.

items.question: Do I still need the browser extension?
items.answer: Yes. The MCP server cannot run on its own. Every page visit happens in the MediaClaw extension in your browser, and the agent can only use capabilities you approved there.

items.question: Can it get my account banned?
items.answer: Collection uses normal page visits in your own browser, and the extension paces them. Before large jobs the agent states the batches and risk level and waits for you. No tool can guarantee zero risk, so follow platform rules and avoid long bursts of continuous collection.

items.question: Can it publish RedNote posts for me?
items.answer: No. The MediaClaw MCP server only collects, extracts and analyzes. It does not publish posts, like or auto-comment. For automated publishing, look at open-source projects such as xiaohongshu-mcp.

items.question: Is it free?
items.answer: The browser extension is free. Agent access needs an active membership, and paid features such as video transcripts use credits with a quote before running. Analysis and writing on the agent side do not use MediaClaw credits.
